about_the_game:
VAMPOTANIC

Plant deadly flowers. Defend against endless hordes. Rebuild your collection in the greenhouse.

Play as Poppy – an immortal vampire and ruthless collector of rare botanical specimens. When a mysterious cult raids her greenhouse and disappears into the Dark Forest, there's only one proper response: revenge.

Grow lethal plants, combine their powers into devastating synergies, fight off cultist hordes, and reclaim what was taken from you.
Seed by seed. Bloom by bloom.

Each run offers a new forest layout, fresh challenges, new plant types, and tough decisions.

Plant and Defend

Your towers are living organisms — they grow, mutate, and kill. Each battlefield is a proving ground for your botanical army. Collect new plants, buy rare seeds, and expand your deadly arsenal.

  • Plant units with unique roles: offensive, support, or economy

  • Build defense lines that can handle every type of enemy

  • Upgrade your plants mid-run — raw power or tactical finesse? You choose

Create Synergies

The strongest builds don’t come from individual plants — they’re born from clever combinations. This is chemistry... with a body count.

  • Mix effects like burning, freezing, slowing, and area damage

  • Build synergy-based loadouts — from eco engines to pure DPS

  • Experiment with layouts and interactions to find your ideal combo

Fight and Decide

Poppy doesn't hide behind her plants. When the vines need backup, she steps in with an axe and dark magic. After each battle, choose the next path forward. Every run is a unique experience.

  • Hack enemies apart in a fast, satisfying melee combat system

  • Use movement and active abilities to stay in control

  • Choose your route through the Dark Forest — every decision leads to new arenas, events, and loot

Add to your wishlist and help Poppy rebuild her infernal greenhouse — because flower destroyers don’t deserve mercy.

short_description: Slash zealots, ignite forests, plant carnivorous flora, and fortify your cursed garden in this gothic roguelite tower defense. Play as a bloodthirsty vampire who fights, burns, and survives wave after wave of holy invaders.
